SBA loans may be used for working capital, real estate, equipment, business acquisition and certain refinancing needs, depending on the program. The SBA does not set a single minimum credit score for all loans. Lenders review credit as part of the overall application. Loan amounts vary by loan program, financing purpose and borrower qualifications. Requirements vary, but lenders often request tax returns, financial statements, business details and ownership information. items.title: Lovelace Westside Hospital Completes Medical-Surgical Expansion to Meet Growing Community Needs
items.summary: Lovelace Westside Hospital Completes Medical-Surgical Expansion to Meet Growing Community Needs wroberts Thu, 07/23/2026 - 15:37 ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (July 10, 2026) – Lovelace Westside Hospital has expanded its inpatient capacity with the addition of 15 new medical-surgical beds, increasing access to care for patients across Rio Rancho and Albuquerque's Westside as the region continues to grow. The newly renovated unit features modern patient rooms with updated finishes, new flooring and warm, welcoming design elements that support comfort, healing and an exceptional patient experience. "As our community grows, so does the need for greater access to high-quality hospital care," said Tracie Stratton, chief executive officer of Lovelace Westside Hospital. "Adding these new inpatient beds allows us to care for more patients close to home while enhancing the environment where they receive care. This investment reflects our ongoing commitment to expanding access and ensuring our hospital is well-positioned to meet the healthcare needs of our community for years to come." The expansion is part of Lovelace Westside Hospital's continued investment in delivering exceptional, patient-centered care while strengthening healthcare access throughout New Mexico. By increasing inpatient capacity, the hospital is better equipped to meet rising demand, reduce wait times and ensure patients can receive timely, compassionate care close to where they live. To learn more about Lovelace Westside Hospital and its commitment to providing quality, compassionate care, visit lovelace.com . About Lovelace Westside Hospital Lovelace Westside Hospital (LWSH) just celebrated its 40th birthday of serving Rio Rancho and Westside residents of Albuquerque high quality, convenient care. The 92-bed acute care facility includes a 24-hour emergency department where patients typically see a provider in 30 minutes or less. LWSH has been recognized by the American Heart Association (AHA) for its commitment to guideline adherence and quality improvement for stroke patients, earning the AHA’s Get With The Guidelines® - Stroke GOLD PLUS for four years in a row (2021 – 2024). The hospital offers services tailored to everyone in the family, including surgical services, sleep studies, a nationally-accredited bariatrics program and more. Money and the Leapfrog Group named LWSH to their list for 2022 Best Hospitals and Surgery Centers for Billing Ethics, showing its dedication to delivering the highest quality of care for patients, while ensuring adherence to the maximum ethical standards for billing. To learn more about the state-of-the-art treatment options, innovative health care providers and award-winning quality initiatives at Lovelace Westside Hospital, visit lovelace.com .

items.title: GRESIK MINE LOCATED IN PAPUA, INDONESIA
items.summary: GRESIK MINE LOCATED IN PAPUA, INDONESIA mboyle Thu, 07/23/2026 - 13:36 Operation Region INDONESIA Ores Copper and Gold Ores Location Display Order 2 Modal Background Image Map Location id #gresik_link Left Column • PTFI’s Smelter and Precious Metals Refinery • PT Smelting (Copper Smelter and Refinery) Description PTFI’s smelter at Manyar, Gresik, East Java, and the nearby PT Smelting operation smelt and refine all of the copper concentrate from PTFI, and the Precious Metals Refinery at the Manyar smelter processes anode slimes from the smelter and PT Smelting. Did you know? With the completion of PTFI’s smelter and precious metals refinery (PMR) (collectively, PTFI’s downstream processing facilities) in Gresik, Indonesia, during 2025, PTFI is a fully integrated producer of refined copper and gold. Location Gresik is a city and regency located in East Java Province, Indonesia, on the island of Java. Gresik is approximately 650 kilometers east of Jakarta. Background During 2024, construction of PTFI’s smelter in Eastern Java, Indonesia, was completed. In October 2024, during start-up activities, a fire occurred that required a temporary suspension of smelting operations to complete repairs. Operations commenced in May 2025 following completion of repairs, and in July 2025, PTFI’s smelter produced its first copper cathode. Following the September 2025 mud rush incident, smelting operations in Indonesia at both PTFI’s smelter and PT Smelting were adjusted as a result of limited copper concentrate availability. In late December 2025, PT Smelting resumed operations. Shipments to PTFI’s smelter are expected to recommence in the second half of 2026 at a reduced rate dependent on available copper concentrate from mining operations at the Grasberg Block Cave underground mine. The PMR has operated on a limited basis since the September 2025 mud rush incident, primarily processing anode slimes from PT Smelting. PT Smelting is an Indonesia company that owns a copper smelter and refinery in Gresik, Indonesia. In 1996, PTFI entered into a joint venture and shareholder agreement with Mitsubishi Materials Corporation to jointly construct the PT Smelting facilities. PT Smelting commenced operations in 1999. In December 2023, PT Smelting completed the expansion of its capacity by 30% to process approximately 1.3 million metric tons of copper concentrate per year. Right Column Smelter Capacity PTFI’s Manyar smelter has a capacity to process approximately 1.7 million metric tons of copper concentrate per year. In 2025, copper anode production from PTFI’s smelter totaled 54,100 metric tons and copper cathode production from its refinery totaled 42,600 metric tons. As part of start-up activities, PTFI commenced gold production from the PMR in December 2024 and operated on a limited basis during 2025, primarily processing anode slimes from PT Smelting. The PMR has a design capacity to refine anode slimes from PTFI’s smelter as well as from PT Smelting. Anode slimes processed through the PMR totaled 1,900 metric tons in 2025. PT Smelting has a capacity to process approximately 1.3 million metric tons of copper concentrate per year. Ownership 48.76% of PTFI is owned by FCX; 51.24% share ownership is collectively held by PT Mineral Industri Indonesia (MIND ID), an Indonesia state-owned enterprise, and PT Indonesia Papua Metal Dan Mineral (formerly known as PT Indocopper Investama), which is expected to be owned by MIND ID and the provincial/regional government in Central Papua, Indonesia. PT Smelting is PTFI’s 66%-owned smelter and refinery in Gresik, Indonesia. Mitsubishi Materials Corporation owns the remaining 34% of PT Smelting’s outstanding common stock and serves as the operator of the facilities.
